questions.stem: The Ranji Trophy, the premier domestic first-class cricket tournament in India, is named after which cricketer?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy (started 1934-35) is named after Kumar Shri RANJITSINHJI (1872-1933), Jam Saheb of Nawanagar — first Indian to play Test cricket (for England, 1896). Innovator of the leg glance. The Duleep Trophy (started 1961-62) is named after his nephew K.S. DULEEPSINHJI. VIJAY HAZARE TROPHY (List A one-day, started 2002-03) named after Vijay Hazare, captain of India's first Test win (1952). IRANI TROPHY (since 1959-60) between Ranji champion + Rest of India, named after Z.R. Irani (BCCI treasurer). Col. C.K. NAYUDU was independent India's first Test captain (1932, England series). DEODHAR TROPHY (List A, zonal) named after D.B. Deodhar.

questions.stem: The Thomas Cup and Uber Cup are international team trophies in which sport?
questions.explanation: BADMINTON: Thomas Cup (men's team world championship since 1949, held every 2 years) + Uber Cup (women's team world championship since 1957). INDIA WON THOMAS CUP for the FIRST TIME in 2022 (Bangkok) — historic achievement (Lakshya Sen, K. Srikanth, Chirag Shetty, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, Prannoy). TENNIS team trophies: Davis Cup (men), Billie Jean King Cup (women). TABLE TENNIS: Swaythling Cup (men), Corbillon Cup (women). CHESS: Chess Olympiad's Hamilton-Russell Cup. CRICKET: World Cup ODI + T20. HOCKEY: World Cup, FIH Pro League. FOOTBALL: FIFA World Cup. Other cups: Durand Cup (football, India's oldest since 1888; third-oldest in world after FA Cup 1871 and Scottish Cup 1873), Santosh Trophy (football interstate).

questions.stem: The largest cricket stadium in the world by seating capacity is:
questions.explanation: NARENDRA MODI STADIUM at Motera (Ahmedabad, Gujarat) — reopened Feb 2021 — seats 1,32,000 (1.32 lakh), surpassing the previous record held by Melbourne Cricket Ground (~100,000). Originally the Sardar Patel Stadium (1983-2020), renamed after PM Modi by the GCA. Hosted India-Pakistan 2023 World Cup match (130k+ attendance — set cricket world record). MCG (Australia) is now 2nd; Eden Gardens (Kolkata) 3rd at ~68,000; Lord's ('Home of Cricket') ~30,000. Other large Indian stadiums: Rajiv Gandhi Intl Stadium Hyderabad (55k), M Chinnaswamy Bengaluru (40k), Wankhede Mumbai (33k), M.A. Chidambaram (Chepauk) Chennai (38k), Arun Jaitley Stadium Delhi (41k).

questions.stem: In which sport is the term 'Chinaman' used?
questions.explanation: CRICKET: 'Chinaman' refers to a left-arm unorthodox spin bowler (left-arm wrist-spinner) — effectively the mirror of a right-arm leg-spinner. Named after West Indian Ellis 'Puss' Achong (1930s), of Chinese descent. Famous exponents: Brad Hogg (Australia), Kuldeep Yadav (India), Paul Adams (South Africa). Cricket has MANY specific terms: BOUNCER, YORKER, BEAMER, DOOSRA (off-spinner bowling leg-spin), TEESRA, CARROM BALL (fingerspin — Sunil Narine), DILSCOOP, RAMP SHOT, DLS method, POWERPLAY, NIGHTWATCHMAN. Other sport-specific terms: Deuce/Advantage/Break (Tennis), Birdie/Eagle/Albatross/Bogey (Golf), Grand Slam (Tennis/Cricket), Hat-trick (Cricket/Football/Hockey), Double fault (Tennis).

questions.stem: The Duleep Trophy in Indian cricket is a competition between:

options.option_text: State Ranji champion + Rest of India

questions.explanation: DULEEP TROPHY (since 1961-62) is an Indian first-class zonal cricket tournament — traditionally between India's 5 cricket zones (North, South, East, West, Central). Since 2022-23 season, replaced with 3-4 teams format: India A, B, C, D (no longer strictly zonal). Named after K.S. DULEEPSINHJI (nephew of Ranjitsinhji), who played for England. The IRANI CUP (since 1959-60) is between the Ranji champion + Rest of India (as named in option A). VIJAY HAZARE TROPHY = List A one-day inter-state. SYED MUSHTAQ ALI TROPHY = T20 inter-state. CK NAYUDU TROPHY = Under-25 first-class. COOCH BEHAR TROPHY = Under-19. VIJAY MERCHANT TROPHY = Under-16.

questions.stem: The Agha Khan Cup, one of the oldest trophies in Indian sports, is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Hockey trophies: AGHA KHAN CUP (started 1896 in Bombay — one of the OLDEST field hockey tournaments in the world), Beighton Cup (Calcutta, 1895), Obaidullah Gold Cup (Bhopal), Bombay Gold Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy. Also: Azlan Shah Cup (Malaysia-hosted international invitational). Football trophies: Durand Cup (1888 — oldest football tournament in Asia, 3rd oldest in the world), Santosh Trophy, Federation Cup, DCM Trophy. Cricket: Ranji Trophy, Irani Cup, Duleep Trophy. Polo: Ezra Cup (oldest polo trophy in India — Kolkata), IPA (Indian Polo Association) Championship.

questions.stem: The Wankhede Stadium, home ground of Mumbai Cricket Association, is located in which city?
questions.explanation: Stadium-city mapping (Indian major cricket venues): Wankhede Stadium = Mumbai (MCA); Eden Gardens = Kolkata (CAB — India's oldest cricket ground, 1864); Feroz Shah Kotla / Arun Jaitley Stadium = Delhi (DDCA); M.A. Chidambaram Stadium (Chepauk) = Chennai (TNCA); M. Chinnaswamy Stadium = Bengaluru (KSCA); Rajiv Gandhi Intl Stadium = Hyderabad (HCA); Narendra Modi Stadium (Motera) = Ahmedabad (GCA); Punjab Cricket Assoc IS Bindra Stadium = Mohali; Sawai Mansingh Stadium = Jaipur; Barabati Stadium = Cuttack; JSCA Stadium = Ranchi; Holkar Stadium = Indore; Vidarbha CA Stadium = Nagpur; Greenfield Stadium = Thiruvananthapuram.

questions.stem: The 'Indian Grand Prix' of Formula 1 was held from 2011 to 2013 at which Indian circuit?
questions.explanation: BUDDH INTERNATIONAL CIRCUIT (BIC) in Greater Noida, UP, hosted the Indian Grand Prix (F1) for three seasons: 2011, 2012, 2013. Designed by Hermann Tilke. Length: 5.125 km. Cancelled in 2014 due to tax disputes + declining organiser interest. Sebastian Vettel won all three editions. BIC now hosts MotoGP Bharat since 2023. Kari Motor Speedway (Coimbatore) and MMRT (Irungattukottai near Chennai) are other Indian tracks. India does NOT currently have an active F1 GP. The F1 India tour added MotoGP contract under FMSCI.
